subject: Re: BrightLayer pricing & model mix — next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>

Cc: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Jul 2026 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: BrightLayer pricing & model mix — post-call recap and next steps

Hi Rajesh—

Thanks again for taking the call earlier. Quick recap and the asks we discussed so we can align on pricing and next steps: 

Recap:
- Use case: customer support + knowledge base augmentation (chat + embeddings for retrieval) and a small reranking flow for triage.
- Key metric: P95 latency goal ~350ms for chat, embeddings used asynchronously for search.
- Current infra: internal ElasticSearch + small microservices, willing to centralize model serving with Redwood Dedicated later.

Asks / open items for pricing qualification:
1) Token volumes by model type (monthly): rough split across chat / embeddings / rerank. We discussed a 70/25/5 split but you said usage might skew more to embeddings during search spikes.
2) Target budget range for hosted inference or committed Dedicated capacity (monthly). If you can provide a $/month target or $/1M tokens goal that helps us recommend the right model mix.
3) Any compliance constraints (data residency, SOC2 required) that would affect deployment mode.

Attachments: I attached a short pricing summary and a template to fill token estimates (BrightLayer_Token_Estimates.xlsx) — if you complete the sheet we can provide line-item pricing and a projection for 3 months.

Next steps:
- Rajesh to populate the token estimates sheet and give a target $/1M tokens or monthly budget range.
- Redwood will return a per-model cost projection and recommended model/quantization mix.
- Rafael will prepare options for Dedicated vs Hosted and highlight expected latency and unit economics.

If easier, we can run a short pricing workshop with your engineering and procurement teams — Rafael and I can join.

Thanks,

Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | (415) 555-0182

Attachment: Redwood_Pricing_Summary.pdf (summary of pricing bands and $/1M token examples)
Attachment: BrightLayer_Token_Estimates.xlsx (please fill with monthly volumes and model splits)

From: Rajesh Gupta <rajesh.gupta@brightlayer.com>

Cc: Procurement <procurement@brightlayer.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Jul 2026 09:23:00 -0700
Subject: Re: BrightLayer pricing & model mix — post-call recap and next steps

Marissa —

Thanks for the clear recap. I filled the token estimate sheet and attached it. High-level numbers:
- Expected monthly active users: 120k
- Average tokens per chat session (prompt + response): ~600 tokens
- Chat volume: ~3.6B tokens/month
- Embeddings (batch + realtime): ~1.2B tokens/month (mostly batch nightly jobs)
- Rerank / scoring: ~200M tokens/month
- Model split: chat 72%, embeddings 24%, rerank 4% (close to our initial 70/25/5 estimate)

Budget guidance: Procurement asked for a target unit cost <= $1,000 per 1M tokens as a reference for hosted pricing — we understand this depends on model selection and latency. If Dedicated with a 12-month commit can achieve better unit economics that would be attractive.

Compliance: SOC 2 is required; data is US-only for now.

I've attached BrightLayer_Token_Estimates.xlsx. Let me know if you want to set up 30 minutes to walk through numbers with Rafael and Monica.

Best,
Rajesh
Sr. Product Manager, BrightLayer
rajesh.gupta@brightlayer.com
Attachment: BrightLayer_Token_Estimates.xlsx

From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>

Date: Wed, 15 Jul 2026 13:48:00 -0700
Subject: Re: BrightLayer pricing & model mix — post-call recap and next steps

Rajesh / Marissa —

Thanks for sending the estimates, Rajesh — looked through the sheet. A few quick notes on unit economics and model recommendations based on the volumes you shared: 

Prelim unit economics (hosted API, RedModel-v1 family):
- Chat (RedChat-v1, 8k context, quantized): ~$900 / 1M tokens
- Embeddings (RedEmbed-small): ~$150 / 1M tokens (batch-friendly)
- Rerank (RedRank-compact): ~$700 / 1M tokens

If the 70/25/5 split holds, blended hosted cost estimate: 
- Chat 3.6B tokens -> 3,600 * $0.0009 = $3,240/month (note: converting units: 1M tokens = $900)
- Embeddings 1.2B -> 1,200 * $0.00015 = $180/month
- Rerank 0.2B -> 200 * $0.0007 = $140/month
Blended monthly hosted cost ~ $3,560 (note: these numbers assume per-1M unit pricing; we can provide more precise line items).

However — these raw numbers look off vs your procurement target because of unit conversion. To align on procurement's target of <= $1,000 / 1M tokens, we need to clarify whether that target was intended as a blended enterprise goal across all models or specifically for chat. For chat-heavy workloads, Dedicated reserved capacity with optimized quantization and batching could push chat unit cost down to ~$450 / 1M tokens at your volumes and commit level.

Next suggested actions:
1) We can run a short cost-model exercise: reproduce your sheet into our pricing model and produce an apples-to-apples comparison (Hosted vs Dedicated 12-month commit).
2) Workshop with engineering to validate latency profiles and acceptable model variants (e.g., RedChat-v1-quant vs RedChat-v1-8bit). Monica — can you prepare a short slide on expected latency/throughput for Dedicated options?

I'll schedule a 30-min workshop for next week unless you prefer a different cadence.

-Rafael
Solutions Lead | Redwood Inference
rafael.mendes@redwood.com

Rajesh —

Appreciate the details and the filled sheet — that helps a lot. Quick clarifications to help Rafael and Monica finalize the pricing workshop prep: 

1) Procurement target: Rajesh, can you confirm if the <= $1,000 / 1M tokens target is meant as a blended target across all usage, or specifically a target for chat (where cost is highest)? If blended, is procurement ok with different per-model targets (e.g., higher for chat, lower for embeddings)?

2) Spike protection: are nightly embedding batch jobs parallelizable across a wider window, or do you need them to finish within a strict SLA? That affects whether we recommend batch-optimized endpoints vs standard embeddings API.

3) Commitment timeline: are you interested in a 12-month Dedicated commit or exploring hosted first and committing later? Dedicated gives the best unit economics at your volumes.

Proposed 30-min workshop slots (Mon/Tue next week): 10:00am PT or 2:00pm PT. Rafael / Monica will cover cost model + latency tradeoffs + a sample Dedicated configuration.

If procurement prefers, Rafael and I can include a sample commitment scenario that shows blended $/1M tokens vs per-model breakdown so they can see the delta.

Thanks — looking forward to locking the next steps.

Best,
Marissa
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
